title: vernonia oligocephala
intro: Vernonia oligocephala, commonly known as the "Bitter Astringent" or "Iron Weed", is a plant species native to Mexico and parts of Central America, belonging to the Asteraceae family. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which can help treat various ailments such as fever, diarrhea, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Vernonia oligocephala include astringent, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a valuable natural remedy for treating respiratory issues and wounds. The plant's bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
